name: Frenzy
desc: If you use Reckless Attack while your Rage is active, you deal extra damage to the first target you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack. To determine the extra damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. The damage has the same type as the weapon or Unarmed Strike used for the attack.

name: Mindless Rage
desc: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active. If you're Charmed or Frightened when you enter your Rage, the condition ends on you.

name: Retaliation
desc: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

name: Intimidating Presence
desc: As a Bonus Action, you can strike terror into others with your menacing presence and primal power. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore it.

name: Bonus Proficiencies
desc: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

name: Cutting Words
desc: When a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration; roll your Bardic Inspiration die and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll, reducing the damage or potentially turning the success into a failure.

name: Magical Discoveries
desc: You learn two spells of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list (or any combination), each a cantrip or a spell for which you have spell slots. You always have the chosen spells prepared, and can replace one whenever you gain a Bard level.

name: Peerless Skill
desc: When you make an ability check or attack roll and fail, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration; roll the die and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning a failure into a success. On a failure, the Bardic Inspiration isn't expended.

name: Disciple of Life
desc: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell, equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.

name: Life Domain Spells
desc: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells prepared: at Cleric level 3, Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, and Lesser Restoration; at 5, Mass Healing Word and Revivify; at 7, Aura of Life and Death Ward; at 9, Greater Restoration and Mass Cure Wounds.

name: Preserve Life
desc: As a Magic action, present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of Channel Divinity to evoke healing energy equal to five times your Cleric level, divided among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet (including yourself). This can't restore a creature above half its Hit Point maximum.

name: Blessed Healer
desc: The healing spells you cast on others heal you as well. Immediately after you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to one or more creatures other than yourself, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.

name: Supreme Healing
desc: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore Hit Points with a spell or Channel Divinity, use the highest number possible for each die instead of rolling.

name: Circle of the Land
desc: Choose one type of land — this determines which spells you always have prepared at 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th Druid level (see Circle of the Land Spells).

name: Circle of the Land: Arid
desc: You always have the Arid land spells prepared for your Druid level and lower: 3 Blur, Burning Hands, Fire Bolt; 5 Fireball; 7 Blight; 9 Wall of Stone.

name: Circle of the Land: Polar
desc: You always have the Polar land spells prepared for your Druid level and lower: 3 Fog Cloud, Hold Person, Ray of Frost; 5 Sleet Storm; 7 Ice Storm; 9 Cone of Cold.

name: Circle of the Land: Temperate
desc: You always have the Temperate land spells prepared for your Druid level and lower: 3 Misty Step, Shocking Grasp, Sleep; 5 Lightning Bolt; 7 Freedom of Movement; 9 Tree Stride.

name: Circle of the Land: Tropical
desc: You always have the Tropical land spells prepared for your Druid level and lower: 3 Acid Splash, Ray of Sickness, Web; 5 Stinking Cloud; 7 Polymorph; 9 Insect Plague.

name: Land's Aid
desc: As a Magic action, expend a use of Wild Shape and choose a point within 60 feet — vitality-giving flowers and life-draining thorns appear in a 10-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature of your choice in the Sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failure (half on success); one creature of your choice regains 2d6 Hit Points. Both dice increase to 3d6 at level 10 and 4d6 at level 14.

name: Natural Recovery
desc: Cast one of your Circle Spells-prepared level 1+ spells without expending a slot, once per Long Rest. Also, on a Short Rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your Druid level (round up), none 6th level or higher — once per Long Rest.

name: Nature's Ward
desc: You're immune to the Poisoned condition, and you have Resistance to a damage type based on your current land choice: Arid → Fire, Polar → Cold, Temperate → Lightning, Tropical → Poison.

name: Nature's Sanctuary
desc: As a Magic action, expend a use of Wild Shape to summon spectral trees and vines in a 15-foot Cube within 120 feet, lasting 1 minute. You and allies there have Half Cover, and allies gain your Nature's Ward Resistance while inside. Move the Cube up to 60 feet as a Bonus Action.

name: Improved Critical
desc: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

name: Remarkable Athlete
desc: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. Immediately after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Additional Fighting Style
desc: You gain another Fighting Style feat of your choice.

name: Heroic Warrior
desc: During combat, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration whenever you start your turn without it.

name: Superior Critical
desc: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18-20.

name: Survivor
desc: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and rolling 18-20 on one counts as rolling a 20. At the start of each of your turns, if you're Bloodied with at least 1 Hit Point, you regain 5 plus your Constitution modifier Hit Points.

name: Open Hand Technique
desc: Whenever you hit with an attack granted by Flurry of Blows, impose one effect of your choice: Addle (target can't make Opportunity Attacks until its next turn), Push (Strength save or pushed up to 15 feet), or Topple (Dexterity save or Prone).

name: Wholeness of Body
desc: As a Bonus Action, roll your Martial Arts die and regain that many Hit Points plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Usable a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regained on a Long Rest.

name: Fleet Step
desc: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after it.

name: Quivering Palm
desc: When you hit with an Unarmed Strike, expend 4 Focus Points to start lethal vibrations lasting a number of days equal to your Monk level. Later, as an action (or forgoing an attack), end them: the target makes a Constitution save, taking 10d12 Force damage on a failure (half on success). Only one creature can be affected at a time.

name: Oath of Devotion Spells
desc: Your oath ensures you always have certain spells prepared: at Paladin level 3, Protection from Evil and Good and Shield of Faith; at 5, Aid and Zone of Truth; at 9, Beacon of Hope and Dispel Magic; at 13, Freedom of Movement and Guardian of Faith; at 17, Commune and Flame Strike.

name: Sacred Weapon
desc: When you take the Attack action, expend a use of Channel Divinity to imbue one Melee weapon you're holding with positive energy for 10 minutes: add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls with it (minimum +1), it deals its normal damage type or Radiant, and it sheds Bright Light 20 feet plus Dim Light 20 feet beyond.

name: Aura of Devotion
desc: You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Immunity to the Charmed condition; a Charmed ally entering the aura has the condition suppressed while there.

name: Smite of Protection
desc: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and allies in your Aura of Protection have Half Cover until the start of your next turn.

name: Holy Nimbus
desc: As a Bonus Action, imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power for 10 minutes (once per Long Rest, restorable by expending a level 5 spell slot): Advantage on saves forced by a Fiend or Undead, enemies starting their turn in the aura take Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier plus Proficiency Bonus, and the aura sheds sunlight.

name: Hunter's Lore
desc: While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know whether it has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and what they are.

name: Hunter's Prey
desc: Gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

name: Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer
desc: When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d8 damage to the target if it's missing any of its Hit Points. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

name: Hunter's Prey: Horde Breaker
desc: Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target, that is within the weapon's range, and that you haven't attacked this turn.

name: Defensive Tactics
desc: Gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

name: Defensive Tactics: Escape the Horde
desc: Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

name: Defensive Tactics: Multiattack Defense
desc: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

name: Superior Hunter's Prey
desc: Once per turn when you deal Hunter's Mark damage to the marked creature, you can also deal that extra damage to a different creature you can see within 30 feet of the first.

name: Superior Hunter's Defense
desc: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to gain Resistance to that damage (and any other damage of the same type) until the end of the current turn.

name: Fast Hands
desc: As a Bonus Action, make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools or to pick a pocket, or take the Utilize action, or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires it.

name: Second-Story Work
desc: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and you can determine your jump distance using Dexterity rather than Strength.

name: Supreme Sneak
desc: Gain the Stealth Attack Cunning Strike option (Cost: 1d6): if you're Invisible from the Hide action, this attack doesn't end that condition if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover.

name: Use Magic Device
desc: You can attune to up to four magic items at once. When a magic item property expends charges, roll 1d6 — on a 6, use it without expending charges. You can use any Spell Scroll with Intelligence as your spellcasting ability, casting cantrips/1st-level spells reliably and higher-level ones with a successful Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 plus the spell's level), or the scroll disintegrates on failure.

name: Thief's Reflexes
desc: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat: your first turn at your normal Initiative, your second at your Initiative minus 10.

name: Draconic Resilience
desc: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and by 1 again whenever you gain another Sorcerer level. While unarmored, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

name: Draconic Spells
desc: You always have certain spells prepared: at Sorcerer level 3, Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, and Dragon's Breath; at 5, Fear and Fly; at 7, Arcane Eye and Charm Monster; at 9, Legend Lore and Summon Dragon.

name: Elemental Affinity
desc: Your draconic magic has an affinity with a damage type associated with dragons. Choose one of those types — you have Resistance to it, and when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

name: Elemental Affinity: Acid
desc: You have Resistance to Acid damage, and when you cast a spell that deals Acid damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

name: Elemental Affinity: Cold
desc: You have Resistance to Cold damage, and when you cast a spell that deals Cold damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

name: Elemental Affinity: Fire
desc: You have Resistance to Fire damage, and when you cast a spell that deals Fire damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

name: Elemental Affinity: Lightning
desc: You have Resistance to Lightning damage, and when you cast a spell that deals Lightning damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

name: Elemental Affinity: Poison
desc: You have Resistance to Poison damage, and when you cast a spell that deals Poison damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

name: Dragon Wings
desc: As a Bonus Action, sprout draconic wings for 1 hour (or until dismissed), granting a Fly Speed of 60 feet. Usable once per Long Rest, or again by spending 3 Sorcery Points.

name: Dragon Companion
desc: Cast Summon Dragon without a Material component, and once without a spell slot (regained on a Long Rest). You can forgo Concentration when casting it, reducing its duration to 1 minute.

name: Dark One's Blessing
desc: When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points (or someone else does within 10 feet of you), you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level (minimum 1).

name: Fiend Spells
desc: Your patron ensures you always have certain spells prepared: at Warlock level 3, Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, and Suggestion; at 5, Fireball and Stinking Cloud; at 7, Fire Shield and Wall of Fire; at 9, Geas and Insect Plague.

name: Dark One's Own Luck
desc: After seeing a roll but before its effects, add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw. Usable a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once, max once per roll), regained on a Long Rest.

name: Fiendish Resilience
desc: Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, choose one damage type other than Force — you have Resistance to it until you choose a different one.

name: Hurl Through Hell
desc: Once per turn on a hit, force the target to succeed on a Charisma save (vs. your spell save DC) or be hurled through the Lower Planes: it takes 8d10 Psychic damage (unless it's a Fiend) and has the Incapacitated condition until the end of your next turn. Usable once per Long Rest, or again by expending a Pact Magic spell slot.

name: Evocation Savant
desc: Choose two Evocation Wizard spells of level 2 or lower and add them to your spellbook for free. Whenever you gain access to a new spell slot level, add one more Evocation spell of an eligible level to your spellbook for free.

name: Potent Cantrip
desc: When a creature avoids the full effect of your damaging cantrip (you miss, or it succeeds on its save), it still takes half the cantrip's damage but suffers no other effect.

name: Sculpt Spells
desc: When you cast an Evocation spell affecting other creatures you can see, choose a number of them equal to 1 plus the spell's level — they automatically succeed on their save and take no damage on what would be a half-damage success.

name: Empowered Evocation
desc: Whenever you cast a Wizard spell from the Evocation school, add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

name: Overchannel
desc: When you cast a Wizard spell with a level 1-5 slot that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with it. The first time you do this between Long Rests there's no cost; each subsequent time, you take 2d12 Necrotic damage per spell level (ignoring Resistance/Immunity), increasing by 1d12 each further use.
